SELECT max(season_year) AS season_year
   FROM pricing;

WITH cs AS (
         SELECT v_current_season.season_year
           FROM v_current_season
        )
 SELECT ( SELECT cs_1.season_year
           FROM cs cs_1) AS season_year,
    o.id AS order_id,
    o.order_date,
    o.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    c.farm_name,
    c.phone_number,
    o.brand_grower_pct,
    o.early_pay_pct,
    o.subtotal_before_discounts,
    o.brand_grower_discount_total,
    o.tote_bulk_discount_total,
    o.subtotal_after_discounts_before_early_pay,
    o.early_pay_discount_total,
    o.total_after_all_discounts,
    o.total_profit AS order_total_profit,
    o.avg_profit_per_unit,
    o.total_units,
    o.created_at AS order_created_at,
    o.updated_at AS order_updated_at,
    oi.id AS order_item_id,
    oi.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    oi.treatment_id,
    t.treatment_name,
    oi.seed_size,
    oi.package_type,
    oi.units,
    oi.retail_price_per_unit,
    oi.tote_bulk_discount_per_unit,
    oi.line_subtotal_before_discounts,
    oi.brand_grower_discount_amount,
    oi.tote_bulk_discount_amount,
    oi.line_total_after_discounts_before_early_pay,
    oi.early_pay_discount_amount,
    oi.line_total_after_all_discounts,
    oi.break_even_price_per_unit,
    oi.profit_per_unit,
    oi.total_profit AS line_total_profit,
    oi.created_at AS order_item_created_at
   FROM order_items oi
     JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
     JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
     JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
     JOIN treatments t ON t.id = oi.treatment_id
     JOIN cs ON o.season_year = cs.season_year;

SELECT o.id,
    o.order_date,
    o.customer_id,
    o.brand_grower_pct,
    o.early_pay_pct,
    o.subtotal_before_discounts,
    o.brand_grower_discount_total,
    o.tote_bulk_discount_total,
    o.subtotal_after_discounts_before_early_pay,
    o.early_pay_discount_total,
    o.total_after_all_discounts,
    o.total_profit,
    o.avg_profit_per_unit,
    o.total_units,
    o.created_at,
    o.updated_at,
    o.season_year,
    c.customer_name,
    c.farm_name,
    c.phone_number
   FROM orders o
     JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.season_year = (( SELECT max(pricing.season_year) AS max
           FROM pricing));

SELECT pc.season_year,
    pr.product_name AS product,
    pr.crop,
    pr.chu,
    pr.seed_trait,
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN tr.treatment_name = 'PONCHO'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN pr.crop = 'corn'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 56.65, 2)
                WHEN pr.crop = 'soybean'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 10.40, 2)
                ELSE NULL::numeric
            END
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS "PONCHO",
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN tr.treatment_name = 'FUNGICIDE'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN pr.crop = 'corn'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 56.65, 2)
                WHEN pr.crop = 'soybean'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 10.40, 2)
                ELSE NULL::numeric
            END
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS "FUNGICIDE",
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN tr.treatment_name = 'FUNGICIDE OPTIMIZE'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN pr.crop = 'corn'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 56.65, 2)
                WHEN pr.crop = 'soybean'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 10.40, 2)
                ELSE NULL::numeric
            END
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS "FUNGICIDE OPTIMIZE",
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN tr.treatment_name = 'Fung/Insect'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN pr.crop = 'corn'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 56.65, 2)
                WHEN pr.crop = 'soybean'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 10.40, 2)
                ELSE NULL::numeric
            END
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS "Fung/Insect",
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN tr.treatment_name = 'DIAMIDE'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN pr.crop = 'corn'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 56.65, 2)
                WHEN pr.crop = 'soybean'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 10.40, 2)
                ELSE NULL::numeric
            END
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS "DIAMIDE",
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN tr.treatment_name = 'Poncho/i-374'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN pr.crop = 'corn'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 56.65, 2)
                WHEN pr.crop = 'soybean'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 10.40, 2)
                ELSE NULL::numeric
            END
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS "Poncho/i-374",
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN tr.treatment_name = 'Fung/Insect/Opt'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN pr.crop = 'corn'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 56.65, 2)
                WHEN pr.crop = 'soybean'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 10.40, 2)
                ELSE NULL::numeric
            END
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS "Fung/Insect/Opt",
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN tr.treatment_name = 'Fung/Insect/Ilevo'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN pr.crop = 'corn'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 56.65, 2)
                WHEN pr.crop = 'soybean'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 10.40, 2)
                ELSE NULL::numeric
            END
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS "Fung/Insect/Ilevo"
   FROM pricing pc
     JOIN products pr ON pr.id = pc.product_id
     JOIN treatments tr ON tr.id = pc.treatment_id
  GROUP BY pc.season_year, pr.product_name, pr.crop, pr.chu, pr.seed_trait;

SELECT pr.season_year,
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.crop,
    p.chu,
    p.seed_trait,
    t.id AS treatment_id,
    t.treatment_name,
    pr.retail_price,
        CASE
            WHEN lower(p.crop) = 'corn'::text THEN pr.retail_price - 0.075 * pr.retail_price - 56.65
            WHEN lower(p.crop) = 'soybean'::text THEN pr.retail_price - 0.075 * pr.retail_price - 10.40
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS break_even_price
   FROM pricing pr
     JOIN products p ON p.id = pr.product_id
     JOIN treatments t ON t.id = pr.treatment_id;

SELECT pc.pricing_year,
    pr.product_name,
    pr.crop,
    pr.chu,
    pr.seed_trait,
    tr.treatment_name,
    pc.retail_price,
        CASE
            WHEN pr.crop = 'corn'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 56.65, 2)
            WHEN pr.crop = 'soybean'::text THEN round(pc.retail_price - 0.075 * pc.retail_price - 10.40, 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS break_even_price
   FROM pricing pc
     JOIN products pr ON pr.id = pc.product_id
     JOIN treatments tr ON tr.id = pc.treatment_id;

SELECT pc.season_year,
    pr.product_name AS product,
    pr.crop,
    pr.chu,
    pr.seed_trait,
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN tr.treatment_name = 'PONCHO'::text THEN pc.retail_price
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS "PONCHO",
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN tr.treatment_name = 'FUNGICIDE'::text THEN pc.retail_price
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS "FUNGICIDE",
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN tr.treatment_name = 'FUNGICIDE OPTIMIZE'::text THEN pc.retail_price
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS "FUNGICIDE OPTIMIZE",
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN tr.treatment_name = 'Fung/Insect'::text THEN pc.retail_price
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS "Fung/Insect",
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN tr.treatment_name = 'DIAMIDE'::text THEN pc.retail_price
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS "DIAMIDE",
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN tr.treatment_name = 'Poncho/i-374'::text THEN pc.retail_price
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS "Poncho/i-374",
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN tr.treatment_name = 'Fung/Insect/Opt'::text THEN pc.retail_price
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS "Fung/Insect/Opt",
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN tr.treatment_name = 'Fung/Insect/Ilevo'::text THEN pc.retail_price
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS "Fung/Insect/Ilevo"
   FROM pricing pc
     JOIN products pr ON pr.id = pc.product_id
     JOIN treatments tr ON tr.id = pc.treatment_id
  GROUP BY pc.season_year, pr.product_name, pr.crop, pr.chu, pr.seed_trait;
